basics.name: Parth Lunagaria
basics.headline: Senior Software Engineer (React Native & Next.js)
basics.availability: Immediate / Open to Remote & Hybrid across India
basics.summary: Results-driven Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience architecting and delivering scalable, high-performance React Native mobile apps and Next.js web platforms across B2B and B2C domains. Deep expertise in the React Native New Architecture, Native Module bridging (Kotlin & Swift), GraphQL, REST APIs, real-time WebSockets, BLE hardware integrations, and Razorpay payments.

skillCategories.title: Architecture, AI & Delivery
skills: AI Coding Tools (Antigravity, Claude, Gemini, Cline)

bullets: Architected and delivered full-stack web and mobile platforms for agriculture-sector B2B and B2C clients using React Native and Next.js.
Led end-to-end requirement analysis, technical architecture, authentication, API integration, and responsive UI delivery independently.
Implemented role-based access control, product/order management, seamless cart & checkout workflows, and real-time push notifications across Android, iOS, and web.
Owned sprint roadmaps, client communication, performance optimization, and production deployments across mobile and web.
Led React Native mobile application development across Travel Booking, Event Management, Social Networking, and BLE wearable products.
Drove mobile application architecture, sprint planning, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), project estimations, and technical decision-making.
Managed projects independently while collaborating directly with US and domestic clients to refine requirements and ship milestones.
Mentored junior engineers and enforced high code quality through thorough code reviews, modular state management, and reusable components.
Built custom Native Modules (Kotlin/Swift) and background services for BLE connectivity, crash/fall detection, real-time tracking, and payment gateways.
